A FAULT is an error this app raised on an automation path \\u2014 a send whose outcome the provider never confirmed, a voice call whose result never came back, a rule disarmed because its parent switch is off. A fault usually leaves the journey running, so it moves no status and appears in no journey count; on this bench there were eleven failed journeys in total against twenty-seven faults in a single week.
